name: Rumination
source:
Rumination is an experimental work [Yuumei] did for [her] Interactive Narratives class. The story plays out like a choose your own adventure book, but no matter what you choose, it all leads to the same ending. 

The story is not meant to say that we have no choices in life, but that there is no point in ruminating about a past that can't be changed. I use to waste away my days dreaming about what I could have done to save my parents' marriage, only to wake up to the realization that the past is gone, but I still have a future ahead of me."

[Edited from [url=https://www.deviantart.com/yuumei/art/Rumination-215250277]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
《反芻》是Yuumei為互動敘事課程創作的實驗作品。故事像一本「選擇你自己的冒險」書，但無論你選擇什麼，最終都會走向同一個結局。

本作並不是要說人生沒有選擇，而是想表達：對於無法改變的過去反覆煩惱也無濟於事。我曾經每天沉浸在「如果當時做了什麼，或許就能挽救父母婚姻」的幻想裡，直到醒悟：過去已經消逝，但我仍擁有未來。

[改編自[url=https://www.deviantart.com/yuumei/art/Rumination-215250277]DeviantArt[/url]]
